scope: Belfry of Bruges, the brick market hall ranges around the open court and the square-facing entrance as recorded in 2005.

originalReview.notes: The exact photograph shows the belfry from Markt, its square masonry stages, tall octagonal crown, two clock faces, openwork parapet and red-brick market hall.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact native Qualla photo is Julien Bertrand’s own work, released to the public domain. Additional photographs from the article have other licenses and were excluded.
